name: Imbiss Alixpress
kurzbeschreibung:
**Street Food Alixpress in Fulpmes** – Your quick and tasty stop in the heart of Tirol!

Enjoy authentic **Döner Kebabs**, fresh **Burger**, crispy **Fischfilet**, and more – all made with love and served fast. Whether you're craving something savory or sweet, our **Imbiss** has it all.

Located right in **Fulpmes**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, we’re the perfect pit stop for hikers, travelers, and locals alike. Come by for a bite and experience the best of **Tiroler** flavors in minutes!

**Opening Hours:**
🕒 Mon–Fri: 11:00 AM – 9:00 PM
🕒 Sat–Sun: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM

**Must-Try:**
🍔 **Döner Kebabs** (classic or spicy)
🌭 **Currywurst** with fries
🍟 **Pommes** (crispy & fresh)
🍦 **Eis** (homemade flavors)

**Pro Tip:** Try our **Tiroler Spezialitäten** like **Kaiserschmarrn** (when available) for a sweet treat!
